description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CreditScoringRequest" name="Credit-scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BankingSystem" name="Banking system credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreditScoringRequested" name="Credit scoring requested through frontend">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CreditScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ImmediateScoringResultReceived" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ImmediateScoringResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DelayNotificationReceived" name="Receive delay notification">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayNotification" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DisplayCheckLaterMessage" name="Display message to check again later" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DelayedScoringResultReceived" name="Receive scoring result after level 2">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayedScoringResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" name="Display immediate scoring result at frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DisplayDelayedResult" name="Display scoring result at frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResultDisplayed" name="Immediate scoring result displayed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DelayedResultDisplayed" name="Scoring result displayed after delay"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_CreditScoringRequested" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_ImmediateScoringResultReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_DelayNotificationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Event_ImmediateScoringResultReceived" targetRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" targetRef="End_ImmediateResultDisplayed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Event_DelayNotificationReceived" targetRef="Task_DisplayCheckLaterMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Task_DisplayCheckLaterMessage" targetRef="Event_DelayedScoringResultReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Event_DelayedScoringResultReceived" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayedResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayedResult" targetRef="End_DelayedResultDisplayed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequestReceived" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 quick scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateResult" name="Is the result determined immediately?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_Agency_Delayed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResultSent" name="Immediate scoring result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotification" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 scoring result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequestReceived" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Immediate" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">resultDeterminedImmediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Delayed" name="Result takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_ImmediateResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Sales clerk software frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_BankingSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CreditScoringRequest" name="Credit-scoring request" sourceRef="Participant_Frontend" targetRef="Start_CreditScoringRequested" messageRef="Message_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Start_ScoringRequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Event_ImmediateScoringResultReceived" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification" targetRef="Event_DelayNotificationReceived" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Event_DelayedScoringResultReceived" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DisplayCheckLater" name="Display check-later message" sourceRef="Task_DisplayCheckLaterMessage" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DisplayImmediateResult" name="Display immediate scoring result" sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DisplayDelayedResult" name="Display scoring result after delay" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayedResult" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
